reason: As written the falsifier does not discriminate and partly cannot run. Defects: (a) no null/control arm; thresholds 4 and 10 x sqrt(Dr)/r uncalibrated: random labels on the same points already give max deviation ~sqrt(r(D+1)ln p/M)~2.5 sqrt(Dr) at D=8,p=2^16. (b) 'maximise over degree-D f' is a search over p^(D+1) ~ 2^144..2^180 polynomials at D=8; only a heuristic lower bound is reachable, so a null result measures optimiser weakness (asymmetric: can only falsify upward). (c) Internal inconsistency: E/F_p prime order r with M in {2,4,16}; M does not divide r so log mod M is not a homomorphism and the merge identity b(P+Q)=b(P)+b(Q) has carry errors; the quotient-by-M structure the claim needs does not exist at prime order (this is the Wagner/no-visible-quotient wall itself). Need M | #E, cyclic. (d) x(P)=x(-P): a function of x is even, log mod M is odd, so for M=4,16 agreement is capped near 1/2 and baseline 1/M is wrong; only M=2 and cos-parts are testable. (e) Merge-gain Monte Carlo has no power: excess scales as eta^3 (sum_chi |ghat|^3), eta~sqrt(D/r)~0.01 => ~1e-6 vs sigma 2.4e-4..5e-4 at 1e6 pairs; the 3-sigma/1.05 criteria detect only eta>=0.1, which is not the regime of the claim; f is also selected on the same points (selection bias). Merge gain involves ALL group characters, not just order-M ones. (f) Floor(fM/p) bucketing adds a log p factor (Fourier expansion of bucket indicator); stated O(sqrt(Dr)) is not the Weil/Kohel-Shparlinski shape D sqrt p; experiment should separate sqrt(D) from D. Scaling to n=131/130-bit: toy can only fit constants and slopes in (log p, D) of an already-theorem-shaped bound (character sums over E(F_p) with additive character of poly(x); Weil/Kohel-Shparlinski, novelty_unverified, not searched here); it gives no information on non-polynomial filters (Legendre/bit-slice) which are the open part of KN-OPEN-91d4f6, and per brief rule 5 the result cannot move B*D^2 below N. Class: relabelling/closure of sub-case, not advance. Runtime as stated (15 CPU-min) is feasible only for the heuristic version; the exact fix is ~5-12 CPU-min with numpy FFT + PARI ellgroup. Not piloted here.
fix: REDESIGN. (1) Group: choose E/F_p with cyclic E(F_p) of order N divisible by 16 (PARI ellcard/ellgroup), G a full generator; prime-order r is INCONSISTENT with log mod M (M does not divide r, log mod M is not additive, carries destroy the merge identity). p in {2^10..2^20}; compute all logs by walking kG (O(N)). (2) Replace 'maximise bucket agreement over p^(D+1) polynomials' (infeasible; any heuristic search measures optimiser power, not the sup) by the exact character-sum sup the claim reduces to: S_j(f)=sum_P psi^j(log P) e_p(f(x(P))), psi=exp(2 pi i/M). Since x(P)=x(-P), only the even part h_j[x]=psi^j(l_x)+psi^-j(l_x) is visible; build h_j over x in F_p, then max_{a1..aD} |S| is exhaustive via batched FFT over a1 for each (a2..aD) (a0 is a unit phase): D=1 p<=2^20; D=2 p<=2^14 (~p^2 log p); D=3 p<=2^11; D=4 p<=2^8. Bucket agreement excess is bounded by sum_h |c_h| |S(hf)| (log p factor from floor expansion; h*f is again degree D) so max|S| controls it. Report T(D,p)=max|S|/sqrt(Dp) and max|S|/(D sqrt p) and fit slopes in log p and log D (Weil/Kohel-Shparlinski predict D sqrt p, claim says sqrt(Dr): the two differ in D-scaling, which this grid can separate: D=1..4). (3) NULL ARM (mandatory, same optimiser, same grid): keep the point set and x-coordinates, replace log by (a) uniformly random permutation of 0..N-1, (b) random even labels; >=20 draws per (p,D,M); real is flagged only if max|S| exceeds the null max over draws (or > 1.25x null median). Random null already gives sqrt(r(D+1)ln p) so the original thresholds 4/10 x sqrt(Dr)/r are not calibrated against it. (4) POSITIVE CONTROL: M=2, N=2 mod 4: test Legendre(x-e) with e the rational 2-torsion root (degree (p-1)/2 polynomial) against parity of log; expect agreement ~1 if the 2-descent map applies (verify empirically, do not assume). Shows the polynomial boundary lies between D<=4 and (p-1)/2 and that the harness can detect a real filter; also plant f* (degree D) and relabel points by bucket(f*(x)) to confirm the DFT max recovers it (sensitivity check). (5) MERGE GAIN: drop the 1e6-pair Monte Carlo (sigma=sqrt((1/M)(1-1/M)/1e6)=2.4e-4..5e-4 vs predicted excess ~eta^3~1e-6 for eta~0.01: zero power; it detects only catastrophic eta>=0.1). Compute the gain EXACTLY on the cyclic group via DFT over log index: g_j=omega^(j b(x(P))), gain=1/M+(1/M) sum_{j!=0} sum_chi ghat_j(chi) conj(ghat_j(chi))^2 (all N characters chi, not only the order-M ones; b depends on x only so it is even). Evaluate for the argmax f and also for top-K DFT peaks, on a train/test split of points for the f-selection only (selection bias otherwise), report gain-1/M against null f's of equal selection effort. Pass criterion relative to null, not 1.05/M. (6) M>=3 caveat: x-only keys are even, homomorphic labels are odd, so only Re psi^j parts and M=2 are meaningful; restate claim for even characters. (7) Metrics are structural (character-sum moduli, exact agreement counts, exact additive-triple correlation), not wall time; CPU est. 5-12 min total.
